title: Final · Direct Tax Laws & International Taxation · May 2024 · Question paper

draft.notes: The question paper comprises Part II containing 6 questions. Question 1 is compulsory. Candidates have to answer any 4 out of the remaining 5 questions. All questions carry 14 marks each, including internal options.
